win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: The client asked for something small.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: They meant the budget.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: You left the frame?

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: I respect their decorating choices.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: Rocco. Our device is on this list.

bubbles.speaker: sprocket
bubbles.text: Our device is on the delivery list.

bubbles.speaker: rocco
bubbles.text: We keep the works. All of them.

bubbles.speaker: sprocket
bubbles.text: The Curator will not like that.

win_bubbles.speaker: tuck
win_bubbles.text: That wall was missing something.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: A museum somewhere agrees.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: The label is newer than the paint.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: Someone rewrote whose painting this was.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: There's a second layer. A hidden archive.

bubbles.speaker: sprocket
bubbles.text: Barnaby Bramble hid records inside it.

bubbles.speaker: rocco
bubbles.text: A restorer with secrets. I like him.

bubbles.speaker: sprocket
bubbles.text: Four more, hidden in four works.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: Bottom entry only. Mind the gaps.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: Colors can wait. We cannot.

win_bubbles.speaker: tuck
win_bubbles.text: Five docks now? Getting fancy.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: Right color. Early choice. Careful.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: That's not the artist's mark.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: There's a fortune in the van.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: Then watch the potholes.

win_bubbles.speaker: quill
win_bubbles.text: This stamp proves nothing alone.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: Good. I hate easy answers.

win_bubbles.speaker: quill
win_bubbles.text: The ledger links Atlas to shipping.

bubbles.speaker: quill
bubbles.text: Atlas moves art under false names.

bubbles.speaker: rocco
bubbles.text: We follow the ships, not the Curator.

bubbles.speaker: sprocket
bubbles.text: No more deliveries. Our own job now.

bubbles.speaker: quill
bubbles.text: Next shipment left on a wrong address.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: This crate was sent twice.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: Nobody ships a painting twice by accident.

win_bubbles.speaker: tuck
win_bubbles.text: The frames are lovely. The paperwork isn't.

win_bubbles.speaker: quill
win_bubbles.text: The label points north. The route doesn't.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: A return ticket nobody meant to use.

bubbles.speaker: quill
bubbles.text: The false label hid the real route.

bubbles.speaker: tuck
bubbles.text: Your gallery is filling up fast.

bubbles.speaker: rocco
bubbles.text: It's a collection, not a hoard.

bubbles.speaker: quill
bubbles.text: A sealed shipment waits in the archive.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: Inner colors first. Trust me.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: I always trust you. Mostly.

win_bubbles.speaker: quill
win_bubbles.text: Every crate lists the same foundation.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: Atlas Foundation. Preserving their own story.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: Second fragment. Barnaby was thorough.

bubbles.speaker: sprocket
bubbles.text: Fragment two maps the transfer network.

bubbles.speaker: quill
bubbles.text: Glimmer funds every link of it.

bubbles.speaker: rocco
bubbles.text: Two of five. Halfway to proof.

bubbles.speaker: quill
bubbles.text: Proof needs people, not just files.

bubbles.speaker: quill
bubbles.text: Glimmer is hosting a silent auction.

win_bubbles.speaker: tuck
win_bubbles.text: Black tie. Try not to steal the chairs.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: Only the art. Probably.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: These hues are almost identical.

win_bubbles.speaker: quill
win_bubbles.text: Every buyer here owes Glimmer favors.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: This signature. I've seen it before.

bubbles.speaker: rocco
bubbles.text: The Curator signed this years ago.

bubbles.speaker: sprocket
bubbles.text: So the Curator worked for Atlas.

bubbles.speaker: quill
bubbles.text: An unsigned letter could prove it.

bubbles.speaker: rocco
bubbles.text: Where would a designer hide it?

bubbles.speaker: tuck
bubbles.text: In storage. Designers never throw things away.

win_bubbles.speaker: tuck
win_bubbles.text: I know this designer's style.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: Then you know where he hides things.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: Half an invitation. Where's the rest?

win_bubbles.speaker: quill
win_bubbles.text: The ink matches the Curator's letters.

win_bubbles.speaker: quill
win_bubbles.text: Verified. Same hand, same signature.

bubbles.speaker: quill
bubbles.text: The Curator is inside Atlas's history.

bubbles.speaker: rocco
bubbles.text: Then we stop taking his calls.

bubbles.speaker: quill
bubbles.text: Two collections claim the same painting.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: Islands of color. Keep a spare dock.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: I always keep a spare something.

win_bubbles.speaker: tuck
win_bubbles.text: Two salons, two proud owners.

win_bubbles.speaker: quill
win_bubbles.text: One record, assigned to two objects.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: Someone erased a family from this.

bubbles.speaker: rocco
bubbles.text: A history copied onto a stranger.

bubbles.speaker: sprocket
bubbles.text: The restoration archive holds the originals.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: Early inner colors cost us later.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: Everything costs us later.

win_bubbles.speaker: quill
win_bubbles.text: This portrait was painted over a name.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: Someone wanted a face forgotten.

win_bubbles.speaker: frost
win_bubbles.text: Hello, Rocco. I'm the Curator.

bubbles.speaker: frost
bubbles.text: I am Mr. Frost. We should talk.

bubbles.speaker: rocco
bubbles.text: You put my device on a list.

bubbles.speaker: frost
bubbles.text: Under one roof, they would be safe.

bubbles.speaker: rocco
bubbles.text: And only you get the key.

win_bubbles.speaker: quill
win_bubbles.text: These records have living grandchildren.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: Then this isn't just a heist.

win_bubbles.speaker: tuck
win_bubbles.text: Calmer colors today. Good for nerves.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: The chest was entrusted, not sold.

win_bubbles.speaker: quill
win_bubbles.text: A family name, finally back.

bubbles.speaker: quill
bubbles.text: The chest came home. So did a name.

bubbles.speaker: rocco
bubbles.text: That felt better than a payday.

bubbles.speaker: tuck
bubbles.text: People want to see your gallery.

win_bubbles.speaker: tuck
win_bubbles.text: Twelve works, one wall, no pressure.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: I work well under pressure.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: Smooth queue. Enjoy it while it lasts.

win_bubbles.speaker: quill
win_bubbles.text: The press is already outside.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: Let them see what Atlas hid.

bubbles.speaker: glimmer
bubbles.text: Young Rocco. You borrowed my things.

bubbles.speaker: glimmer
bubbles.text: Let's discuss this politely. At Atlas.

bubbles.speaker: rocco
bubbles.text: Polite is how you threaten people.

win_bubbles.speaker: glimmer
win_bubbles.text: Every newspaper owes me dinner.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: Then they can pay for it.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: Mystery packets everywhere. Classic Glimmer.

win_bubbles.speaker: quill
win_bubbles.text: He's calling you a common thief.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: Uncommon, surely. Look at this work.

bubbles.speaker: quill
bubbles.text: Glimmer is attacking you through the press.

win_bubbles.speaker: quill
win_bubbles.text: The first draft tells the truth.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: Always keep the first draft.

win_bubbles.speaker: tuck
win_bubbles.text: A short job. Breathe a little.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: Someone edited a witness out.

win_bubbles.speaker: quill
win_bubbles.text: Here's what they said before the press.

bubbles.speaker: quill
bubbles.text: The testimony was rewritten for Glimmer.

bubbles.speaker: sprocket
bubbles.text: The next fragment sits in a closed exhibition.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: Edge rules and mysteries. Fun night.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: Define fun, Sprocket.

win_bubbles.speaker: quill
win_bubbles.text: Guards changed shifts early tonight.

win_bubbles.speaker: tuck
win_bubbles.text: Your museum is all over the news.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: Fragment four. Names of beneficiaries.

bubbles.speaker: quill
bubbles.text: Glimmer, Atlas, and three quiet partners.

bubbles.speaker: frost
bubbles.text: Give me the archive. I'll protect it.

win_bubbles.speaker: quill
win_bubbles.text: Three keys, three keepers.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: Nobody holds everything. I like that.

win_bubbles.speaker: tuck
win_bubbles.text: Even your gallery needs friends.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: The box opens only together.

win_bubbles.speaker: frost
win_bubbles.text: You're building a network against me.

bubbles.speaker: rocco
bubbles.text: An answer to Mr. Frost's single roof.

bubbles.speaker: sprocket
bubbles.text: Atlas is moving its archive tonight.

bubbles.speaker: quill
bubbles.text: They're destroying pages as they go.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: Inner passages. Plan every route.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: I plan. I just don't announce it.

win_bubbles.speaker: quill
win_bubbles.text: Half these pages are ash.

win_bubbles.speaker: tuck
win_bubbles.text: Save what you can, Rocco.

win_bubbles.speaker: quill
win_bubbles.text: A destruction order. Signed by Glimmer.

bubbles.speaker: rocco
bubbles.text: He was always afraid of history.

bubbles.speaker: sprocket
bubbles.text: He wants to negotiate in person.

win_bubbles.speaker: glimmer
win_bubbles.text: Everyone has a price, Young Rocco.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: Mine is the truth. Pay up.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: Short job. Definite pressure.

win_bubbles.speaker: quill
win_bubbles.text: Every contact is watching you now.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: Let them watch. I'm working.

bubbles.speaker: glimmer
bubbles.text: Walk away rich. Or walk away.

bubbles.speaker: rocco
bubbles.text: I'll walk away with the bust.

bubbles.speaker: sprocket
bubbles.text: The device's origin is in Barnaby's work.

bubbles.speaker: rocco
bubbles.text: Then his showcase holds the answer.

bubbles.speaker: quill
bubbles.text: Glimmer keeps one last private showcase.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: Every rule we know, all at once.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: Good. I've practiced.

win_bubbles.speaker: tuck
win_bubbles.text: Almost the whole collection now.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: Barnaby built the first version of our device.

win_bubbles.speaker: quill
win_bubbles.text: One archive left. In Glimmer's own collection.

bubbles.speaker: rocco
bubbles.text: He planned for someone like us.

bubbles.speaker: frost
bubbles.text: Last chance. Bring me the archive.

bubbles.speaker: quill
bubbles.text: Glimmer's principal collection. The last fragment.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: The final queue. No surprises left.

win_bubbles.speaker: rocco
win_bubbles.text: There are always surprises.

win_bubbles.speaker: tuck
win_bubbles.text: I saved a wall for this.

win_bubbles.speaker: quill
win_bubbles.text: Everyone is watching tonight.

win_bubbles.speaker: sprocket
win_bubbles.text: Fragment five. The archive is complete.

open_inventory.title: Open Inventory
open_inventory.line: Publish everything, even what exposes you.

bubbles.speaker: rocco
bubbles.text: Publish all of it. Even me.

bubbles.speaker: sprocket
bubbles.text: The truth is out. Now what?

custodian_network.title: Custodian Network
custodian_network.line: Entrust the record to many careful hands.

bubbles.speaker: rocco
bubbles.text: It looks shared. I like it.

final_bargain.title: Final Bargain
final_bargain.line: Break Glimmer and Mr. Frost with a private deal.

bubbles.speaker: glimmer
bubbles.text: You'd trade the archive for my exit?

bubbles.speaker: sprocket
bubbles.text: Atlas is gone. Nobody knows why.

bubbles.speaker: rocco
bubbles.text: Some stories stay in the vault.

crew.name: Bit
crew.bio: A ladybug who never drops a pixel.

crew.name: Dash
crew.bio: A dragonfly with very fast wings.

crew.name: Gizmo
crew.bio: A beetle who fixes every drone.

crew.name: Hum
crew.bio: A bee who hums while he lifts.

crew.name: Flicker
crew.bio: A firefly who lights dark depots.

crew.name: Pinch
crew.bio: A stag beetle with gentle claws.

crew.name: Velvet
crew.bio: A moth who moves in silence.

crew.name: Tock
crew.bio: A weevil who keeps perfect time.

crew.name: Nova
crew.bio: A jewel beetle who shines last.
